SPY.title: Something Unseen Since The Russian Invasion Of Ukraine Is Happening On Wall Street
SPY.description: Wall Street is experiencing a major sector rotation in early 2026, with energy stocks dramatically outperforming technology by 27 percentage points—the largest gap since Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine. Unlike the previous geopolitical shock, this rotation is driven by AI concerns: while AI boosts productivity, it threatens margins in labor-intensive tech sectors like software and professional services. Investors are shifting toward the 'HALO' strategy (Heavy Assets, Low Obsolescence), favoring asset-heavy industries like energy, utilities, and materials that are less vulnerable to AI automation and have tangible infrastructure backing.
SPY.author: Piero Cingari
